title: Senior Consultant - subsurface
description:
Senior Consultant Subsurface (O&G Upstream) Desired Experience: 3–6 years Mandatory Skill:  Subsurface (Reservoir / Petroleum / Production Engineering domain depth) Preferred Background: Experience with Integrated Oil Companies such as Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP Role Purpose Subsurface Subject Matter Expert (SME) embedded within a digital / AI use case delivery squad, acting as the functional bridge between upstream subsurface stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams (product, data science, data engineering, architecture). The role is non-coding and focuses on shaping, translating, validating, and governing subsurface analytics / AI solutions across the upstream value chain. Operating Model & Reporting Individual contributor role within an Agile / product-style delivery environment; supports functional delivery of subsurface use cases from discovery to deployment. Works closely with upstream business teams (subsurface, production interface points) and technical delivery teams (product managers, data scientists, data engineers, solution architects). Reports to Senior Manager / Manager – Subsurface (O&G Upstream) and supports Consulting Delivery Leadership priorities for SC&O / Digital Ops engagements. Key Responsibilities Subsurface Use Case Discovery & Functional Support Support discovery workshops with subsurface stakeholders to capture decision workflows, value drivers, pain points, uncertainties, and success criteria. Draft and maintain structured documentation under Manager guidance: use case descriptions, functional requirements, assumptions, constraints, and acceptance criteria. Support alignment of target outcomes and operational realism across subsurface-to-production workflows. Digital / AI Use Case Delivery Support (Non-Coding) Translate subsurface requirements into technical inputs for delivery teams (features, inputs, constraints, classifications), ensuring feasibility and traceability. Support domain inputs across upstream analytics / AI solution areas such as: Reservoir performance analytics and forecasting Production surveillance / optimization linkages Well performance diagnostics and root cause analysis Decline analysis and anomaly detection Field development planning decision support Review and validate analytics / AI outputs and dashboards for domain realism and engineering alignment; escalate concerns and recommendations to the Manager. Stakeholder Management & Client-Facing Delivery Engage with subsurface teams, production interface stakeholders, and technical teams to gather structured feedback and convert it into actionable requirements/backlog items. Support pilot deployments and phased rollouts by coordinating feedback cycles and tracking issue resolution with delivery teams. Support preparation of stakeholder-ready narratives and inputs for proposals / solution articulation aligned to subsurface transformation priorities. Governance, Quality & Assurance Support definition and application of data quality checks, engineering assumptions, and validation checkpoints for subsurface datasets and model outputs. Contribute to playbooks, solution documentation, and governance artifacts for deployed use cases. Support UAT planning and execution; document findings and confirm outputs are credible and usable for engineering decision-making. Required Experience & Qualifications 3–6 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong subsurface depth (Reservoir / Production / Petroleum Engineering). Practical understanding of subsurface workflows (not theory-only), including uncertainty handling and data quality considerations. Strong communication and structured documentation skills; ability to translate engineering concepts clearly to non-engineers and technical teams. Demonstrated cross-functional delivery experience spanning engineering / operations / digital teams. Fluency in English (mandatory). Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts. Familiarity with engineering / digital tools (surveillance systems, production databases, BI tools). Arabic language capability (optional).

description:
At FedTec Reply, we are hiring an Innovation Lab leader to join our team. In this role you will be working on building innovative enablers and accelerators for our federal clients. Our ideal candidate is an inspiring technology leader who is a self\-starter, always learning, proactive, and with strong written and verbal communication skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and lead the vision, roadmap, and delivery standards for FedTec's SaaS and AI\-native innovation center, spanning AI transformation, service management, and cybersecurity offerings.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable enablers, accelerators, and reference architectures that reduce cost and time\-to\-value on federal client engagements.
* Recruit, mentor, and manage a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and consultants, building a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
* Partner with business development and capture teams to shape technical solutions, proposals, and win strategies for federal opportunities.
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with cloud, SaaS, and AI technology vendors to bring emerging capabilities into FedTec's federal offerings.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the firm’s technology leaders, translating mission needs into scalable, secure, AI\-enabled solutions.


**Minimum Requirements (Mandatory)**
* 10\+ years experience in technology consulting, solution architecture, or IT capability/practice leadership.
* 4 years experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering or consulting teams.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering SaaS\-based or AI\-native solutions for enterprise or government clients.
* Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST RMF, FedRAMP, Zero Trust).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a premier STEM institution.


**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related technical field from a premier STEM institution.
* Experience with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, large language models, and AI/ML platform engineering.
* Industry certifications such as AWS or Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or CISSP.
* Track record of standing up new practice areas or capability centers from the ground up.


**About Reply**
 Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.

title: Data Science Engineer Internship
description:
Internship Type: Unpaid Internship
 Duration: 3 Months
 Work Mode: Remote
 Experience: Fresher / Students / Recent Graduates
 Location: Kerala / India 
 About the Internship We are looking for a motivated Data Science Engineer Intern who is interested in working on real-world data science and AI projects. This internship provides an opportunity to gain practical experience in data analysis, machine learning, data preprocessing, model development, and deployment. The intern will work on live projects and collaborate with the technical team to develop data-driven solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze datasets. Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA). Develop and evaluate machine learning models. Work with structured and unstructured datasets. Implement feature engineering and data transformation techniques. Use Python libraries for data analysis and visualization. Assist in developing predictive and classification models. Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics. Prepare reports and documentation for data science projects. Work with APIs, databases, and data pipelines when required. Research and experiment with new machine learning and AI techniques. Collaborate with developers and AI/ML engineers on real-world projects. 
 Required Skills Basic knowledge of Python . Understanding of Data Science and Machine Learning fundamentals . Familiarity with: Pandas NumPy Matplotlib / Seaborn Scikit-learn Knowledge of data preprocessing and exploratory data analysis. Basic understanding of statistics and probability. Understanding of machine learning algorithms. Basic knowledge of SQL is preferred. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn new technologies independently. 
 Good to Have Knowledge of TensorFlow or PyTorch. Experience with Jupyter Notebook / Google Colab. Knowledge of NLP or Generative AI. Familiarity with Git/GitHub. Basic knowledge of cloud platforms. Academic, personal, or previous data science projects. 
 Who Can Apply? B.Tech / B.E / B.Sc / M.Sc / MCA students or graduates. Students specializing in Data Science, AI/ML, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related fields. Freshers looking to build a career in Data Science or AI/ML. Candidates who have completed academic or personal machine learning projects. 
 What You Will Gain Experience working on real-world data science projects . Practical exposure to the complete data science workflow. Hands-on experience with Python, ML, data analysis, and visualization. Opportunity to work with an experienced technical team. Project experience that can strengthen your portfolio. Internship completion certificate. Performance-based recognition and potential future opportunities based on company requirements and performance. 

 Important Note This is an unpaid internship opportunity focused on practical learning and real-world project experience. There is no guaranteed employment or stipend during the internship. Future employment opportunities may be considered based on performance, skills, project requirements, and available vacancies.

Key Skills: Python,Artificial Intelligence,Machine Learning,Intelligence,Science,Data Science,Machine,Data
